meta.title: 每个人的使命不一样：不必都当妈妈
meta.title_en: Everyone Has a Different Mission: Not Everyone Must Be a Mother

scenes.title_cn: 使命不同，无所谓谁更好
scenes.context: 讲者回答经济学式的选择问题，指出每个人使命不同，无所谓谁更好。
sentences: 经济学的角度：投资、自我价值实现，还是建立亲密关系，你觉得应该选哪一个？
From an economics angle — investing, self-fulfillment, or close relationships — which should you choose?
自我价值实现：self-fulfillment
每个人到世界上来的使命是不一样的。
Everyone arrives in this world with a different mission.
使命：mission
有的人的使命就是当好妈妈、照顾好孩子，都挺好，无所谓谁更好的问题。
Some people's mission is to be a great mom and raise their kids well — that's great, and neither path is better.
无所谓谁更好：neither path is better
paraphrase: 选择没有统一答案→先承认使命不同
There's no one-size-fits-all answer — missions differ first.
当妈妈与做事→没有高下
Motherhood and doing work are equals, not rivals.
scenes.speak: From an economics angle — investing, self-fulfillment, or close relationships — which should you choose? Everyone arrives in this world with a different mission. Some people's mission is to be a great mom and raise their kids well — that's great, and neither path is better.

scenes.title_cn: 能做专注工作，做不了琐碎
scenes.title_en: Great at focus, not at the daily grind of care
scenes.context: 讲者解释自己使命的来源：能对工作极度专注，但受不了照顾孩子的日常琐碎。
sentences: 我做工作可以非常专注。
I can focus intensely on my work.
非常专注：focus intensely
但你让我长期保持这个专注，然后天天吃喝拉撒，恐怕我不是太接受得了。
But keep that focus going while dealing with diapers and daily care day in and day out? I don't think I could take it.
吃喝拉撒：diapers and daily care
你让我去做一些工作上跟人接触，这我愿意。
Work that puts me in contact with people? That I'm willing to do.
跟人接触：in contact with people
paraphrase: 舒适区=判断使命的线索
Your comfort zone is the clue to your mission.
受得了专注、受不了琐碎→使命清晰
Can't stand the daily grind? Then mission is clear: focus work.
scenes.speak: I can focus intensely on my work. But keep that focus going while dealing with diapers and daily care day in and day out? I don't think I could take it. Work that puts me in contact with people? That I'm willing to do.

scenes.title_en: As a mom, I might fail the role
scenes.context: 讲者承认自己当妈妈在别人眼里可能不负责，所以走着走着走成了现在这样。
sentences: 如果我是一个妈妈的话，在别人眼里恐怕不是一个太负责任的妈妈。
If I were a mom, I'd probably look like a pretty irresponsible one to others.
不负责任：irresponsible
你让我天天去鉴别哪个学校最好，恐怕我也不是太愿意。
And making me vet which school is the best every day? I'm not too keen on that either.
鉴别哪个学校：vet which school
所以我就走着走着，就做成这样了。
So I just kept walking my own path — and that's how I ended up here.
走着走着：walking my own path
paraphrase: 承认不适合当妈妈→是诚实评估
Admitting the role isn't for me is honest self-assessment.
走自己的路→长成使命的样子
Walking my own path is growing into my mission.
scenes.speak: If I were a mom, I'd probably look like a pretty irresponsible one to others. And making me vet which school is the best every day? I'm not too keen on that either. So I just kept walking my own path — and that's how I ended up here.

practice: Everyone has a different mission in life.
Neither path is better — they're just different.
I don't think I could handle the daily grind of childcare.
I kept walking my own path, and that's how I ended up here.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Everyone's mission to the world is different.
✓ 地道说法：Everyone arrives with a different mission.
arrive with a mission 表达「到世上的使命」更自然。
✕ 直译腔：There is no matter of who is better.
✓ 地道说法：Neither path is better.
neither path is better 更简洁。
✕ 直译腔：Day and day, eat drink and poop.
✓ 地道说法：The daily grind of care and diapers.
daily grind of care 表达带娃琐碎更得体。
✕ 直译腔：I am not an accountable mother.
✓ 地道说法：I'd look like a pretty irresponsible mom.
irresponsible 表达「不负责」更口语。
shifts: 女性就该当妈妈，当妈妈才完整
使命不同，无所谓谁更好
人生选择有统一标准答案
选择取决于使命与舒适区
承认不适合当妈妈=不负责
承认不适合才是对人对己负责
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：「坐着坐着」按语境校正为「走着走着」；「天天吃喝拉撒水」按语境校正为「天天围着吃喝拉撒（照顾孩子）」；「鉴别一下哪个学校最好」保留原意；「我就做成这样了」按语境整理。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
